answer: I would rather have one Telegraphist frank registry entry stamped by the telegraph office than ten weaker checks, because each frank is a stamped transit record plus a signed office log, so a farm must run is a wall, not a curtain. The farm must fund 679 separate proofs before the epoch pays a single POA, a bill of 78764 POA in advance. Count the ripple in the file, count the tide in the wallet, and count the shale in the years: the numbers never favour the farm. That is the whole defence: one real cost, applied once per identity.
